issues.description: Compile RPC inlines entire script content instead of exposing a dedicated download endpoint.
issues.detail: The compile_notebook RPC reads the whole file and ships it in every response, even when no one downloads. This bloats memory and bandwidth, complects 'where the artifact lives' with 'what it contains,' and forces the frontend to re-materialize a Blob. A dedicated download/read-file RPC called on click would decompose this cleanly.

issues.description: open() lacks explicit UTF-8 encoding and error handling on a post-success read.
issues.detail: open(script_path) relies on the platform default encoding and has no try/except. If the file is missing, unreadable, or non-UTF-8 on the user's locale, the whole compile_notebook RPC fails after compile actually succeeded. Specify encoding='utf-8' and either guard the read or move it out of the success path.

issues.description: GetAppIcon used as a click target instead of an accessible button.
issues.detail: The SVG icon has onClick and a title attribute but no role, no keyboard handler, and no focus ring. It's unreachable for keyboard and screen-reader users. Wrap in an IconButton or <a download> with aria-label, matching the surrounding 'Done' anchor's voice.

issues.description: Object URL and DOM anchor lifecycle leaks on exception or unmount.
issues.detail: createObjectURL, appendChild, click, removeChild, revokeObjectURL runs inline with no try/finally. If click() throws (CSP, sandboxing) or the component unmounts mid-flight, the Blob URL and orphan node leak. Make the lifecycle explicit with try/finally or a declarative <a download>.

issues.description: Filename derivation via split('/').pop() conflates paths and assumes POSIX separators.
issues.detail: compiledPath appears to reference the pipeline package (yaml) while the download writes the .py script content; the fallback name masks the confusion. Additionally, on Windows-hosted notebook servers, backslash separators would make split('/').pop() return the full path. Name the values distinctly and normalize separators at the server boundary.

issues.description: Duplicated compiledPath and compiledContent state drilled through multiple components.
issues.detail: compiledPath is used only to derive the filename while compiledContent carries the payload, and both flow through DeployProgressState, DeploysProgress, DeployProgress, and Commands. One value would suffice if content were fetched on demand. Eliminate the special case by consolidating on a path plus an on-click fetch.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK: the feature works but its shape is wrong. The compile RPC inlines the entire compiled script into every response, complecting artifact location with artifact contents and forcing a Blob round-trip in the browser — a dedicated download endpoint fetched on click is the correct decomposition. The Python read lacks explicit UTF-8 encoding and error handling, so a post-success IO failure poisons the whole compile result. Frontend concerns cluster around accessibility (SVG-as-button), object-URL lifecycle leaks, fragile filename derivation, and duplicated path/content state drilled through four components. None block merge for a lab extension, but the backend-shape and encoding issues should be addressed before landing.
